Name: Mirin's Museum of Curiosities
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/LXHTsLL1/MMoC.png[/img]

[size=3]Welcome to this little corner hidden away in the museum.[/size]
[size=3]A place for special curiosities![/size]

[size=1]Made for also hosting my other mod's artifact instead of in the main museum![/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khSpT4Y/compatibility.png[/img]

List of compatibilities~
[spoiler]
[size=3]---- Recolours ----[/size]
Uses vanilla tilesheets to make the map, so it should be recolour friendly :3

[size=3]---- Artifact Adding Mods ----[/size]
Should not interfere with them ^^

[size=3]---- Map Changes ----[/size]
I tried to do a very small patch to the museum inside, however if there is a mod that changes that corner (you can see it in the images tab) structure too much then you will be graced with a visual bug :3

[size=3]---- SVE ----[/size]
Yes, it should work with SVE.
The map patch has changed location of trap door to keep the plant interaction cutscene.

No, I am not adding any active support for compatibility - if they shift the museum structure.[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3vBx7vz/configuration.png[/img]
Make sure to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] so you can check your configs easier~
Read carefully!

[spoiler]
[size=3]---- Buff Modification ----[/size]
[b]Luck:[/b] Change the luck buff provided by Mirin's blessing
[b]Defense and Attack:[/b] Change the defense and attack buffs provided by Mirin's blessing
[b]Immunity:[/b] Change the immunity buff provided by Mirin's blessing.

Default are described below.[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JzvFMLL/what-is-added.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#ff0000]Spoilers for the mod ahead, continue with precaution.[/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3]---- Maps ----[/size]

[b]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/b]
[spoiler]
Accessed through a trapdoor inside the museum.

[u]Requirements:[/u]
Seen event with Gunther on museum artifacts - when you have an artifact and enter the museum.
The next time you enter the trapdoor will be visible :o
Interact with plant for a short cutscene and you'll be able to go in.
(The plant returns, unbothered, moisturized, in its little corner, focused, and flourishing).
(If its giving you grief if should appear after 15 in day games, without the additional plant event...) [/spoiler]

[size=3]---- NPCs----[/size]

[b]Mirin[/b]
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/WpMW2r20/20250619191024-1.jpg[/img]

Non-sociable - sorry :(
They can't receive gifts - yet.

They have a schedule within their Museum space and a few dialogue lines and events.
(Mirin no longer needs to be "manning" the Museum to donate to it.)
Their events are an introduction and when completing their collection (triggered after reading a letter they sent!)

Mirin uses a hat for Winter and when sleeping (after certain events when my other mods are present) they'll use a blanket during winter!


This NPC will appear in a future mod of mine, more fleshed out![/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Artifacts/Curios ----[/size]
This mod provides four (4) artifacts which will be named Curios.
[spoiler]
They can be found through digspots in different areas of Pelican Town, including the Farm, Forest, Mountain, Railroad, Beach and Town.
As well as digspots in the Desert.

If its too difficult to find them, the Bookseller may have them sometimes, for a price...
(25% chance of appearing for sale)[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Lost Books ----[/size]

This mod provides two (2) lost books of a single set.
[spoiler]
They can be found through digspots in different areas of Pelican Town, including the Farm, Mountain, Railroad and Town.[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Buffs ----[/size]

[b]Mirin's Blessing[/b]
[spoiler]
Acquired only after a certain event with Mirin!
(Default buffs, can be changed in the config)
Luck: +5
Defense: +10
Attack: +10
Immunity: +10

Lasting all day after the event! Use wisely ><[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Expanded Museum ----[/size]

If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30000]Cosmos[/url] or [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29991]Kath's Wonders and Treats for the Holidays[/url] (or both) are present.
The museum will go through an expansion!
[spoiler]
The expansion will happen after reading Mirin's letter - Meow!!
There is a small event where the hallway expansion is shown.
The next day after that event you will receive a letter announcing that the new expanded area is ready!
(You should be able to donate from those mods once the expansion event is seen and a day is slept -> room ready.)


More about the areas:
[b]Expanded Hallway[/b]
[spoiler]
Mirin's Catwalk, what else can I say :3[/spoiler]

[b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30000]Cosmos[/url] Corner[/b]
[spoiler]
3 lost books can be found.
A plaque on the wall can serve to open the museum menu!
The items to donate are listed in its respective mod page.[/spoiler]

[b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29991]Kath's Wonders and Treats for the Holidays[/url] Corner[/b]
[spoiler]
3 lost books can be found.
A plaque on the wall can serve to open the museum menu!

Toggable fireplace and custom doors using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26849]EMA[/url]!
The items to donate are listed in its respective mod page.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MpXMXFh/to-do.png[/img]
[size=2]Probably will add more to the museum.[/size]
Of course, Mirin will soon have more events and will be able to receive gifts.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/XD8h5KT/special-thanks-and-recommendations.png[/img]
[size=2]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177615852]Spiderbuttons[/url]! I can finally have a little corner that is a museum ><
And to all the mod authors that deal with my questionable testing vv

Highly recommend Daisy Niko's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy Interiors[/url], for a more cozy feeling to Mirin's little corner.[/size]
